hard_criteria.limit: every valid flight landed and disarmed, own commands [176, 400, 21]
all 60 flown, or every unflown flight explained by a stop rule; at most 2 replacements per 20-flight block and one per flight

not_claimed: superiority or inferiority of either ranker
results outside the declared layouts, mission, speed, static boxes or this host
required_statement: This engineering validation was not designed to compare P5 with P4. With 30 pairs, a test of the planning effect would have about 3 % power. Observed differences between the controllers are descriptive and do not show that either is superior.

risk_register.rule: P7-E closes neither; no threshold changes in response (contract §10)

sign_convention: every paired difference is P5 minus P4
statement_of_a_pass: the accepted P4 and P5 stacks completed the declared 60-flight engineering validation through the P7 infrastructure, with every hard criterion H1-H9 met
